notes.title: The latest patch is here!
notes.notes:
Here's what's new!


 Fixed Rex Room Logic for Heart not resetting correctly on Enter.
 Rex Multiball will start automatically when Lit if Rex Hits equals 20.
 Chainsaw Hits no longer count as Rex Hits. 
 Fixed bug where Red Alert Mode/FX was errantly set on start of New Game. 
 Added support for LG Dual Up, let us know if it works!

notes.title: Xmas Eve Patch!
notes.notes:
12/24/2024 (OUT NOW!)

 Balance changes for to make earning Survivor Tokens easier.
 Lowered the Survivor Token Requirement from 9 to 4.
 Lowered cap for Survivor Refund Cost from 6 to 3.
 Secret Jackpot contributes to Survivor Token Progress.
 Super Jackpot contributes to Survivor Token Progress.
 Max S. Token Requirement per game is capped at 6.
 Failsafe for Multiball Stuck in Tomb Room.
 Optimization for Ball Smoke FX.
 Optimization for Score Pips.

notes.title: 1.02 -- transition from Early Access to Release is imminent!
notes.notes:
Ok--here it is....we are in 1.0 land! The exit from Early Access to Release is upon us. We will be making a post about the official Release and our post-launch plans in the next day or so. Stay tuned! Until then, here's what's new in this update:

11/11/2024
-Fix for infinite missile bug.

11-9-2024
-1.0 is here, Thank you!!
-Various fixes to Ball Stuck & Ball Attendant feature.
-Various Minor Fixes.

notes.notes: Sorry about that, upgrading the Steam SDK had tragic consequences and blocked access to Leaderboards and the rest of Steam. We reverted to the older SDK and now it works.

notes.title: YET ANOTHER HOTFIX
notes.notes:
Ok so here's ANOTHER hotfix. Here's what we've done:

* Complete localization. There should be no broken strings
* No erroneous tilt bobs in scoreboards -- we're hiding them until we fix that
* PG UP / PG DN works in scoreboards
* Hardcore Xenoslayer achievement works (I think?!!?)
* You shouldn't be able to get into a 4:3 res. But if so, there's an EMERGENCY RESOLUTIONR RESET key sequence: If you are in the options menu, hold ALT and press 0. It will reset the resolution to 1080p. This way you don't have to edit the registry if you somehow get stuck in a weird resolution.
